scenes.text: Whether you're counting a streak of days doing what builds you up, or days not doing what holds you back, your journey belongs on your phone, not in the cloud.
ClearStreak tracks both daily disciplines and habits you're leaving behind under Data Over Shame. An off day resets today's count, but never erases your lifetime days or milestone coins.
Eyes-free haptic grounding, fingerprint encryption, and zero subscriptions. Start any journey with ClearStreak.
